text: {"kind":"amendment","in_force_since":"2019-03-15","reason":"The 2024-04-01 date is when SB 567's rewritten § 1947.12 became operative, replacing the AB 1482 rent cap that already applied to rent increases on or after March 15, 2019 (and the prior 8.8% cap in effect from Aug 2023 confirms an earlier version)."}
